title: Basic Paso Doble TOP TEN STEPS & ROUTINE

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teachers use a direct, instructional approach, alternating between demonstrating the steps and explaining the technical details. They emphasize the importance of emotion and character in the dance, encouraging students to embody the spirit of the Paso Doble.

lesson_structure.note: The teachers introduce themselves and the dance.
The teachers explain the importance of emotion in the dance.
The teachers address common misconceptions about the dance.
The teachers explain the starting footwork for leaders and followers.
The teachers break down the Promenade Link.
The teachers break down the Chasse to the Right.
The teachers explain how to use YouTube's speed settings to learn.
The teachers break down the Separation.
The teachers break down the Ecart.
The teachers explain the Paso Doble frame.
The teachers break down the Drag.
The teachers discuss the music used for the Paso Doble.
The teachers break down the Displacement.

metaphors: The teachers describe the dance as 'dramatic' and 'passionate', and the dancer as an 'animal on the dance floor'.
common_mistakes: Picking up the foot and stopping it down during the 'Appel' instead of a full, grounded step.
safety: The teachers emphasize the importance of a grounded, compressed step to avoid injury and maintain proper technique.

steps_taught.name: Promenade Link
steps_taught.description: A basic step involving a walk and a close.

steps_taught.name: Separation
steps_taught.description: A step that separates the partners.

steps_taught.name: Ecart
steps_taught.description: A step involving a side lunge and a back step.

steps_taught.name: Drag
steps_taught.description: A step involving a lunge and a slide of the foot.

steps_taught.name: Displacement
steps_taught.description: A step involving a turn and a side lunge.

what_works: The teachers break down the steps for both leaders and followers separately, which makes it easier to follow.
The use of slow-motion demonstrations and clear, concise verbal cues helps students understand the movements.
what_hinders: The rapid pace of the video might be overwhelming for some beginners, even with the slow-motion feature.

quotes.text: To be a great dancer is not just about great movement.
You just need you, yourself, and this video.
Appel is just a closing and a dropping down of the whole foot.
In the Paso Doble, we pan those elbows out.

evidence_segments.observation: The teachers stand in a dance hold and introduce themselves.
The teachers demonstrate the Promenade Link.
The female teacher demonstrates the follower's footwork for the Promenade Link.
The male teacher demonstrates the leader's footwork for the Promenade Link.
The female teacher demonstrates the 'Appel' technique.
The teachers demonstrate the Chasse to the Right.

extraction.distinctive_method: The teachers use a 'crash course' approach, focusing on the top ten steps and providing specific, actionable advice for both leaders and followers.
